question: Who scored the highest individual score in a single innings during IPL 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhishek Sharma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Abhishek Sharma** scored the highest individual score in a single innings during the **IPL 2025**, showcasing an exceptional batting performance.
 
• His innings included a combination of **powerful shots** and strategic gameplay, making him the standout player of the tournament.
 
• Abhishek Sharma's record-breaking score surpassed previous records held by other players in the **Indian Premier League**.
 
• He played for his franchise team with remarkable consistency throughout the tournament, contributing significantly to their success.
 
• The match where he achieved this milestone was highly celebrated, and it highlighted his ability to handle pressure in crucial moments.

__
 
• **Abhishek Sharma**:

 
 
• Born on **4 September 2000**, Abhishek Sharma is a talented Indian cricketer known for his all-round abilities.
 
• He hails from **Amritsar, Punjab**, and has been a part of various domestic and international cricket tournaments.
 
• He is primarily recognized for his aggressive batting style and ability to accelerate the game during middle overs.
 
• Abhishek has represented teams like **Sunrisers Hyderabad** in the IPL and played key roles in their campaigns.
 
 
 
• **Indian Premier League (IPL):**
 
 
• The IPL is one of the most popular **T20 cricket leagues** globally, featuring top players from around the world.
 
• It was established in **2008** and is governed by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**.
 
• The league is known for its competitive matches, entertainment value, and contribution to the growth of cricket.
 
 
 
• **Highest Individual Scores in IPL History:**
 
 
• Before Abhishek Sharma, players like **Chris Gayle** (175*), **Rishabh Pant**, and **KL Rahul** were among the record holders for high individual scores.
 
• Abhishek's record-breaking innings added his name to the list of legendary performances in IPL history.
 
 
 
• **Impact on the Team:**
 
 
• Abhishek Sharma's milestone innings had a significant impact on his team’s morale and overall performance in the tournament.
 
• Such individual achievements often inspire younger players and contribute to the league's excitement.

• **Chris Gayle's record:** He scored **175 not out** in IPL 2013, which was considered the highest individual score until it was surpassed by Abhishek Sharma.
